title: Filipinos in France flagged over cockfighting, illegal gambling

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Embassy in France has warned the Filipino community that cockfighting is illegal in the country amid reports of Filipinos engaging in the activity and associated illegal gambling. In an advisory issued Monday, the embassy said it was alerted by French authorities that some Filipinos were holding cockfighting events and engaging in illegal gambling. The embassy also noted complaints about disturbances and littering associated with the activities. “Filipinos in France are therefore advised that illegal cockfighting is an act of animal cruelty punishable in France by three-year imprisonment and a fine of 45,000 euros,” the Embassy warned.
